note: Single source for the origins the app may connect to and for the Permissions-Policy values (Session T, ADR-012). security-policy.ts, next.config.ts, lib/ai/providers.ts and the deployment checks read this file, through lib/csp-compose.mjs for the policies (Session W); no literal copies elsewhere.

serverOnly.note: Origins only the app's own server code reaches, never the browser: none of them enters connect-src (ADR-014 S2). Each is a secret on the app Worker, unset in every committed config.
serverOnly.zigiRelay: ZIGOALS_ZIGI_RELAY_ORIGIN: ZIGoals hosted's relay (workers/zigi-relay), reached only by /api/zigi (lib/server/zigi-route.ts); off by default
serverOnly.healthLink: ZIGOALS_HEALTH_LINK_ORIGIN: the health-link Worker (workers/health-link), reached only by /api/health-link (lib/server/health-link-route.ts); off by default

csp.note: Session W Part 14: /app documents reach chess.com's and Lichess's public APIs (connect) and frame exactly their daily puzzle, puzzle, TV and game pages (frame), docs/product/CHESS.md. Session W Part 1e: extra connect-src, img-src and frame-src sources per document class ('app' is /app and everything under it, 'site' every other document), in the order they are sent. lib/csp-compose.mjs builds the one policy the app and every check use. Empty lists keep the policy every build since Session V sends: connect-src is 'self' plus the origins above, img-src 'self' data: blob:, frame-src 'none'.
